Subject: ClearHealth — post-call: data ecosystem & security next steps

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single thread for the procurement/security folks.

Call recap (30m):
- Use case: ClearHealth wants to use Redwood API for clinical-notes summarization and patient-facing triage prompts.
- Data type: PHI will be in scope for a subset of routes; team confirmed need for HIPAA controls.
- Traffic profile: expect bursts (demo → pilot) then steadying at ~40 req/s for extractive flows.

Action items I took away:
1) ClearHealth: share your vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned a standard doc) — I attached the copy you dropped in chat so we can track answers in one place.
2) Redwood: provide SOC 2 Type II summary, current subprocessor roster, and a short note on cloud hosting boundaries (what providers see encrypted tokens vs. downstream services).
3) Align on a short 20–30m follow-up next week to go over the DPA language and any redlines.

What I'll share by EOD tomorrow: a redacted subprocessor roster and a SOC 2 summary. I will not post raw audits or customer data; if you need the full SOC 2 report we'll set up an NDA/secure transfer.

Attached: clearhealth_vendor_questionnaire_v1.docx (your questionnaire)

Proposed slots for follow-up: Mon 9/6 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue 9/7 11:00–11:30 PT — let me know what works and I’ll send calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — appreciated. Couple clarifications from our side before you share anything:

- SOC 2: we need to see evidence of Type II within the last 12 months. A short summary is fine to start but eventual transfer of the full report will be required by procurement (NDA/secure portal is fine).
- HIPAA: Please confirm Redwood’s BAA posture and whether you (or any subprocessors) have access to unencrypted PHI.
- Subprocessors: we need a list of all cloud and third-party partners involved in storage or transit of PHI or metadata (including analytics vendors). Specifically ask for the SaaS infra providers, logging/monitoring, and any third-party indexing or embedding services.

Also can you mark anything that is regional (EU/APAC) — we have EU-hosted data considerations for a subset of our users.

We’d like Redwood’s initial answers in a completed copy of our questionnaire (attached). Procurement copied for timeline.

—

Dylan — thanks for the forward and for the clear list. Short answers and next actions from security: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: shareable summary yes. Full Type II report only after an NDA and secure transfer (we provide a time-limited link via our compliance portal).

2) BAA/HIPAA: Redwood executes a BAA for HIPAA-covered workflows. We will confirm the canonical BAA language; for now state: "Redwood is willing to execute a BAA; PHI access is strictly controlled and logged; subprocessors do not access unencrypted PHI in typical flows" — we will refine.

3) Subprocessor roster: we maintain a public roster (redwood-subprocessors-public-2026.csv). That CSV lists primary cloud providers, managed DBs, monitoring/logging vendors, analytics tooling, and CDN providers. It does not include internal account IDs or ephemeral hostnames. Share that CSV as the initial roster.

4) Sensitive detail redaction: redact internal IPs, account numbers, and on-call contact emails. For any subprocessors that perform transformations on PHI (e.g., third-party embedding/indexing partners), we must escalate and share only after legal review; note currently we do not use external embedding vendors on PHI paths in US-hosted deployments — those are internal-only.

5) Regional flags: we can annotate each subprocessor row with a column for region (US|EU|APAC). The public CSV already marks region for primary providers. If ClearHealth needs EU-only hosting for subsets, we will propose a pilot configuration (EU-only routing + dedicated instance) and provide an annex to the DPA.

Next steps (for this thread):
- Dylan: please send Maya the redacted public CSV and the SOC 2 summary PDF. Use the compliance portal link for the full report if procurement asks.
- Aditya: can you prepare a short note on the proposed EU-only pilot and estimated timeline/cost (cc’d).
- Maya: if procurement needs the full report I can initiate secure transfer once NDA is in place.

Attachments I will include in the outbound email: redwood-subprocessors-public-2026.csv, redwood-soc2-type2-summary-2025.pdf

If helpful, I can join the follow-up call to walk the ClearHealth security team through the roster and the DPA annex.

—
Grace O'Connor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
